title: The Last Will Revisited
author: Hazel Halloran
blurb: Vesper Galloway, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
